action: Operation to perform; choose one of the listed action values.
active: Whether the agent webhook sends future matching events.
agent_id: Owned managed agent UUID; webhook actions also accept self for the authenticated agent.
assigned_to: Assignee filter using the identifiers or special values accepted by this action.
assignee_ids: Task assignments use numeric human user ids; saved view filters also accept managed agent UUIDs. These are not display names.
board_filters: Structured filters for a saved board view.
board_id: Numeric board id to restrict the search; a board is a project.
body_html: HTML body of a saved report.
comment_id: Numeric id of an existing comment to edit, delete or attach files to.
composition: Inbox composition selector for notification and task items.
content: Page document body in the selected content_type.
content_type: Text format (HTML or Markdown); for uploaded files, the supported MIME type.
created_by: Numeric user id that created the tickets.
created_since: ISO 8601 lower bound on ticket creation time.
cursor: Opaque continuation cursor from the previous filtered list response; keep the same filters.
definition_of_done: Board completion criteria to store in its playbook.
delivery_id: Existing webhook delivery identifier to replay.
description: Description text for the resource; ticket description format is selected with content_type.
display_name: Human profile display name or the new managed agent's display name.
due_date_after: ISO 8601 lower bound on ticket due dates.
due_date_before: ISO 8601 upper bound on ticket due dates, useful for overdue work.
estimate: Relative ticket size: 0 means no size; 2 through 6 represent XS through XL.
events: Webhook event names to deliver to the configured callback.
exclude_blocked: Exclude tickets with unresolved blocking relations from next-work selection.
expires_in_days: Lifetime of the new account MCP token in days, from 1 to 365.
files: Files to upload; each has filename, content_type and exactly one of data (base64) or url.
filters: Saved view filter configuration for labels, assignees and other supported fields.
format: Requested page representation, such as Markdown, HTML or JSON.
from: Start date of the time-report range in ISO 8601 form.
has_attachments: Require tickets with attachments when true, or without attachments when false.
has_comments: Require tickets with comments when true, or without comments when false.
has_due_date: Require tickets with a due date when true, or without a due date when false.
has_pr: Filter linked PR state; red indicates failing checks or a closed PR.
id: Existing page identifier, an alias of page_id.
if_version: Expected current page version; reject the update if another edit changed it.
label: Label name to match in a structured filter.
label_names: Board label names to include in a task manifest or saved view filter.
labels: Label filter or assignment values in the shape accepted by this action.
limit: Maximum rows requested from the existing endpoint; use the top-level limit to cap the response.
match: Whether saved view filter groups match all criteria or any criterion.
mentions: Objects containing user_id and display_name to resolve and notify comment mentions.
metadata_filters: Structured constraints on semantic retrieval source metadata.
mode: Page update mode: replace or append the supplied content.
model_selected: AI model preference to store in board instructions.
name: Label or skill name to create or update.
note: Explanatory note attached to this time entry, page update or decision answer.
notification_ids: Inbox notification identifiers to archive or restore, not task identifiers.
offset: Number of matching rows to skip; prefer cursor continuation when supported.
order: Sort direction for the selected field.
page_id: Existing page id or public page identifier accepted by page actions.
parent_page_id: Existing parent page identifier for a nested page.
photo_url: Public URL of the authenticated human user's profile image.
priority: Ticket priority index or supported priority name; 0=None, 1=Urgent, 2=High, 3=Medium, 4=Low.
project_id: Board id discovered with projects list or user_context; usually numeric, while time reports accept its string form.
project_ids: Numeric board ids to which the new managed agent will belong.
query: Text to search; ticket search also supports documented search operators.
revoke_all: Revoke all signed account MCP tokens when true; use only with explicit user approval.
role: Managed agent role on its assigned boards.
running: Restrict the time report to currently running entries when true.
search: Text filter for the existing task or project list.
section: Workflow column title to match, not the ticket storage status.
section_id: Numeric workflow column id; discover it with projects manifest.
set_as_default: Make the saved view the user's default board view.
slug: Stable report or skill slug used to locate the document.
sort_by: Field to sort the result list by.
sorting_stack: Ordered multi-field sorting configuration for a saved view.
source_project_id: Numeric board id for a source ticket identified by source_unique_index.
source_task_id: Numeric source ticket id for a link or unlink action.
source_ticket_number: Stable source ticket key, for example HTPR-1234.
source_unique_index: Source ticket number within source_project_id; both fields must be supplied together.
status: Storage state for tasks or projects (Normal, Archive, Deleted), or decision state where supported; not a workflow column.
summary: Request the shorter ticket-context representation when true.
target_project_id: Destination board id for a move, or target board id for relation identification.
target_task_id: Numeric target ticket id for a link or unlink action.
target_ticket_number: Stable target ticket key, for example HTPR-1235.
target_unique_index: Target ticket number within target_project_id; supply both fields together.
task_id: Numeric ticket id; get accepts an array, while other actions usually accept a single id.
task_identifier: Numeric ticket id or full ticket key such as HTPR-1234 for timer actions.
team_id: Team or workspace identifier discovered through user_context.
text: Comment, draft or related-search text; comment formatting uses content_type.
ticket_number: Stable full ticket key such as HTPR-1234; tasks get accepts an array of keys.
title: Human-readable title of the ticket, board, column, page or view.
to: End date of the time-report range in ISO 8601 form.
token: Signed account MCP token to revoke; never include it in user-visible output.
unique_index: Ticket number within a board; requires project_id. Prefer ticket_number when known.
updated_since: ISO 8601 lower bound on ticket update time.
url: HTTPS webhook callback, remote skill source, or HTTP(S) upload source, depending on the action.
user_id: Numeric human user identifier; time reports also accept me for the authenticated user.
view_id: Saved board view UUID discovered by views list.
visibility: Whether a saved view is shared (Public) or private to its owner (Private).
visible_section_ids: Numeric column ids to display in the saved board view.
working_rules: Board-specific workflow instructions to store in the playbook.
member_identifier: One human user id, email address or managed agent UUID to add to the board.
